anomalies.observed: On the FCC sheet, the left-hand net label "VREF+_FCC" sits at the level of MCU pin 13 (PH1). The MCU's VREF+ pin 20 has no visible label or wire. The VREF+ filter (R42, C109, C16) is also labelled VREF+_FCC on the right. Pin 13 is a crystal-oscillator pin, so the reference-voltage filter may be tied to PH1 rather than VREF+.
anomalies.expected: VREF+ (pin 20) should be the only MCU pin on the VREF+_FCC net, with the VREF+ filter (R42/C109/C16) connected to it. PH0/PH1 should remain on the HSE oscillator network, not share a net with the reference filter.

evidence.quote: FCC sheet: left-side label "VREF+_FCC" at pin 13 (PH1); MCU pin 20 VREF+ unlabelled; right-side "VREF+_FCC" label on the VREF+ Filter (R42 47, C109 1u, C16 100n)
In the component table, FCC MCU is STM32H753VITx, and the FCC sheet contains a "VREF+ Filter" block.

anomalies.impact: If the label placement reflects the actual wiring, the VREF+ filter loads the HSE oscillator pin and the ADC reference is left unconnected or floating. This would corrupt ADC readings and could stop the high-speed oscillator from starting.

parsed.summary: The most plausible deviation is that the VREF+_FCC reference-filter net appears to attach to FCC pin 13 (PH1, an oscillator pin) instead of VREF+ pin 20, but the label placement is hard to confirm from the drawing, so confidence is low. The rest of the power, sensing, I2C, and passive values I checked match the specification.
